propositions: Multiple S3 bundles for one ref cause clone failures ('multiple updates for ref not allowed') and push stalls ('multiple bundles exists on server') that prevent convergence, losing the store to cloning until healed.

Upstream's git_remote_s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocks on input() prompts, crashes on EOF) and discards non-chosen heads by default, losing events unique to those heads from the append-only store.

The heal must fold N divergent bundle heads via iterated 2-parent lossless merges (never octopus, never merge=union) following sync's existing per-target reconcile semantics, reusing .gitattributes merge=ours for .bridge_state/* and never discarding a parent.

The heal writes the merged tip as a new bundle before deleting any original bundle and never deletes the merged tip, guaranteeing ≥1 lossless bundle remains at every crash point; mid-delete crashes re-heal idempotently to a single bundle on the next run.

The heal serializes via git_remote_s3's own acquire_lock/release_lock per-ref lock (60s TTL, conditional-put), enumerates bundles under the lock (TOCTOU guard), and routes all S3 ops (list, put, delete) through the helper's S3Remote/.s3 client, with boto3 transitive under [s3] and no hard core dependency.

push_tickets_branch auto-invokes heal_multi_bundle exactly once on multi-bundle stderr signatures (healed_once guard) before normal non-FF recovery, retries the push, and converges without infinite retry loops.
